**Switch-off releases the context by both IDs**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / UE Context Management Procedures / UE Context Release (AMF initiated) |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 20s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Owns | release after switch-off |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.3.3.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: IE-handling sentences are added after V15.0.0, and 8.3.3.1 is extended to mention releasing the old connection when the UE establishes a new one; the UE NGAP ID sentences are unchanged from V15.0.0 through V19.4.0; Rel-16: further IE-handling sentences are added; the UE NGAP ID sentences are unchanged)
- TS 23.502 4.2.2.3.2 step 8 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "AMF sends N2 UE Release command to RAN", "to NG-RAN" by V15.17.0; graded as a requirement: the step states the AMF's release of the N2 signalling connection in the indicative, with no alternative; Rel-16: the non-3GPP sentence names N3IWF/TNGF/W-AGF; the NG-RAN sentence is unchanged from V15.17.0 through V19.9.0)
- TS 24.501 5.5.2.2.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 titles the clause "UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion - common procedure", "UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion" by V15.7.0; the AMF sentences are unchanged from V15.0.0 through V19.8.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-CTX-RELEASE-AFTER-SWITCH-OFF.md).
